title: knowledge(performance): align SetLoadFields placement with AL Guidelines
summary: BCQuality aligned SetLoadFields code examples with AL Guidelines by placing filters before SetLoadFields, clarifying that this order is a readability convention rather than a performance requirement.
key_points: Reordered SetLoadFields to appear after SetRange/SetFilter in six AL code samples to match AL Guidelines convention
Documented that the order does not affect query projection, as filtered fields are always loaded regardless
Added explicit guidance that readability placement is not a performance defect to prevent false-positive review warnings
Updated documentation to clarify the distinction between readability and behavioral requirements
quote: The order is a readability convention, not a behavioural one.
